source.denominatorDefinition: Part B numbered list items + Part C data table rows + Part D bullet items and data table rows; headings, prose context and table headers are not independent rule units

reviewChecklists.requiredEvidence: For every DESIGN or IMPLEMENTATION adversarial round beginning with the next review cycle: a fresh independent-subagent blind verdict formed before author material, reviewerKind=INDEPENDENT_SUBAGENT, reviewer input checklist path+hash, blind-review declaration, and author dialectical intake with source reopen, primary-source verification where needed, counterexamples, applicability and explicit disposition; implementation reread of the smallest applicable IA/original business item, routed memory and owning sources, detail design/constraints and reusable source remains a recommended review habit, but no prewrite or pointwise record is a machine or package-exit prerequisite; REVIEW_CYCLE_ID plus REVIEW_ROUND 1 or 2 and fixed REVIEW_ROUND_LIMIT 2, with SELF_DECIDED hard stop on round 2; approved Journey/interaction matrix; actor prerequisite-chain readback where identity and required data each declare exactly one source (in-scope produced, established source, or external prerequisite pending Dexter), without silently treating a pending prerequisite as established; every implementation-facing detail design cites its original business requirement/problem and states the business user or owner, current task, and observable success outcome under doc/decisions/2026-07-25-v2s-design-governance-batch-1.md#generic-detailed-design-admission; at least one viable alternative and tradeoff; UI operation-to-user-task proof; for a UI-bearing Journey, a complete interaction artifact meeting doc/decisions/templates/ui-interaction-design-template.md#ui-detailed-design-admission, manifest B.4/B.5 hit mapping with an applicable frozen Heritage asset or explicit N/A reason, Dexter low-fidelity visual review, and when applicable a high-fidelity demo ledger plus DEXTER_HIFI_REVIEW conclusion; when a cs-* adapter was used, a SKILL_USED=<adapter>@<frozen-vendor-sha256> header plus human verification that its phase and output match the adapter; ambiguity attribution and Dexter ruling when product semantics differ; task-specific L2 evidence or an explicit UI NOT_APPLICABLE justification; for every Claude review of design or implementation-facing design, an attached manifest Part B (B.1-B.6), Part C normative-pattern groups, and Part D chapter-level hit map that gives each chapter or Part C group either rule IDs plus design locations or NOT_APPLICABLE plus reason—without this table the review material is incomplete and cannot issue GO/NO-GO
trigger/applicability decision, exact Heritage source reopen, and rejection of topology-inapplicable copying
current owner, supersession, evidence immutability, naming and authorization-boundary readback

finite scope and an independently reviewable batch (split any delivery exceeding about 30 minutes of reviewer inspection); from the next review cycle, every DESIGN or IMPLEMENTATION adversarial round is a fresh independent-subagent blind review with reviewerKind=INDEPENDENT_SUBAGENT, explicit mandatory-input checklist path+hash and blind-review declaration before author material, followed by author dialectical finding disposition that rejects unverified scope growth and overdesign; semantic/user-task judgment remains fresh independent review rather than a keyword-style checker; new or expanded machine gates pass the three-question test (recurring error, purely mechanical verdict, lifecycle cost below future rework), drive production, and have a behavior-changing red mutation; maximum two adversarial rounds per cycle/target/approved scope and no reviewer/model/file/hash reset; round-2 SELF_DECIDED closure or direct Dexter escalation; at least one alternative; independent oracle; discriminator; business/cleanup separation; source and real-user-behavior evidence for implementation; minute-scale verify with the weakest low-discrimination gate removed before accepting slowdown; and no superseded ceremony; for every Claude review of design or implementation-facing design, an attached manifest Part B (B.1-B.6), Part C normative-pattern groups, and Part D chapter-level hit map that gives each chapter or Part C group either rule IDs plus design locations or NOT_APPLICABLE plus reason—without this table the review material is incomplete and cannot issue GO/NO-GO
exact version spike or explicit deferred decision, whitelist proof and no silent compatibility line
human-started v2s-rooted review proves CLAUDE.md entry-chain readback; no unverified second hook configuration

fresh independent-subagent implementation adversarial verdict, author finding intake with owning-source reopen, current R4 production validator and red-fixture evidence, and Claude whole-scope implementation review. This checklist owns standards that require architectural, security, logging, retirement, database-query or UI-traceability semantic judgment beyond a one-line mechanical predicate.
